The program provides up to two years of support for teams seeking to translate laboratory results into products, with milestones tied to technical and market validation. Awardees are expected to conduct customer discovery interviews, develop a prototype that meets defined performance specifications, and prepare a plan for intellectual property protection. In the first phase, funding of up to $275,000 covers technical risk reduction, such as scaling a fabrication process or demonstrating reliability under realistic operating conditions. A second phase, available to teams that achieve their milestones, supports pilot manufacturing and early deployment with industry partners. Proposals are evaluated on intellectual merit and broader impacts, along with the strength of the commercialization plan. The solicitation lists eligibility criteria and submission deadlines, and proposals must be submitted through the agency's electronic system.
